summary: Apply CCPS RBPS, HAZOP, and process safety metrics in five practical days. Review the course outline and plan your training.
lede: Risk-based process safety management gives process safety and operations professionals a structured way to prioritize major accident hazards. They can assess HAZOP and LOPA findings, review critical safeguards and management-of-change records, and turn findings into tracked corrective actions through risk registers, indicator reporting, and incident learning.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess process hazards, maintain safeguards, or oversee process safety controls in operating facilities. This course is designed for: Process Safety Engineers who coordinate hazard studies and track recommendations. Process Safety Managers who oversee RBPS elements and site assurance. Operations Supervisors who verify operating limits and critical procedures. Process Control Engineers who review alarm and instrumented safeguards. Loss Prevention Engineers who assess major accident scenarios and barriers. EHS Specialists who maintain process safety action and incident records. Maintenance and Reliability Engineers who manage safety-critical equipment integrity. Management of Change Coordinators who screen process modification requests. Process Safety Auditors who test RBPS implementation evidence and closeout. Capital Project Engineers who integrate process hazard reviews into design.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of process operations, process hazards, or EHS responsibilities is recommended. No programming is required. Bring familiarity with routine operating, maintenance, or process safety records; advanced analytics and AI topics receive conceptual coverage rather than implementation training.
